description: Operator — a concrete, callable execution surface (the canonical invokable artifact; migrates from vnd.agience.transform+json). Its context.operator block names the MCP tool to run (server + tool) and the argument mapping. On invoke, the dispatcher runs that tool server-side, resolving each argument value from the invoke request ($.body.*), the operator's own document ($.content / $.context), and typed edges (@relationship.<name>). Bind a tool, an authorizer, a secret, or another operator by attaching them as relationship edges and referencing them in arguments.

server.description: MCP server short-name (e.g. 'iris') or UUID that owns the tool. Required.

tool.description: Tool name to invoke on the server. Required.

arguments.description: Tool argument map. Each value is resolved: '$.body.params.x' (invoke request), '$.content'/'$.context.x' (this artifact), '@relationship.<name>' (the root_id of a typed edge target, e.g. an attached authorizer), or a literal.
